title: Revenue Operations Data Analyst
description_text:

Started as a WhatsApp team inbox in 2020, Wati has evolved into a full revenue orchestration system that goes beyond a single platform. We empower businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations by observing customer intent in real-time, deciding the next best revenue action, and executing it seamlessly across marketing, sales, and support—all within WhatsApp and connected messaging channels.

The Revenue Operations Analyst will be instrumental in analyzing large datasets to extract meaningful insights that impact our bottom line. You will lead the charge in optimizing our dashboards, maintaining data accuracy, and developing new data pipelines that support strategic decision-making in all aspects of our revenue stream, from sales-qualified lead to customer retention and churn.

Additionally, acting as the thought partner to the GTM team, in order to exploit market-fitted strategy. Contribute to strategic planning efforts by providing data-driven insights on market trends, customer segmentation, and revenue opportunities.
- Data Analysis & Reporting (P1): Utilize advanced SQL skills to query, manipulate, and analyze complex data sets within BigQuery databases to extract key customer insights that inform strategic decision-making. Translate data findings into clear, understandable reports and presentations for stakeholders across the company.
- Data Optimization (P2): Develop, refine, and optimize information flow that provide relevant insights into growth & revenue metrics, customer behavior, and performance.

- Strong experience in SQL and querying large datasets, particularly using BigQuery.
- Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar (Data science experience is a plus).
- In-depth understanding of key SaaS metrics
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
- A self-starter who is ready to take initiative and craft solutions from the ground up.
- Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Portfolio & Risk Analytics
description_text:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.

Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:
- Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves.
- Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed.
- Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation.
- Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results.
- Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession.
Role Overview
As a Senior Lending Analyst focused on portfolio and risk, you own the metrics and reporting that give leadership a clear, forward-looking view of loan portfolio health. You'll work across delinquency, vintage, concentration, and credit loss provisioning analytics to surface early warning signals before risk materialises.
Key Responsibilities
- Portfolio Risk Reporting: Own core credit risk metrics (delinquency rates, non-performing loan ratio, collection rate, provisioning adequacy) and ensure they are accurate, reconciled, and traceable to an approved source of truth.
- Vintage & Origination Analysis: Build and maintain cohort-based analysis of loan performance by origination period to track quality trends across markets and products.
- Concentration & Exposure Monitoring: Track credit concentration risk across borrowers, industries, geographies, and products, and support monitoring against internal risk limits.
- Macro-to-Portfolio Analysis: Connect macroeconomic indicators to portfolio performance, building dashboards that give leadership early visibility into emerging risk.
- Segmentation & Scenario Analysis: Build borrower and portfolio segmentation, and run scenario-based stress tests to identify vulnerable segments ahead of time.
- Collaboration: Partner with Risk, Credit, Data Science, Finance, and Engineering to align on metric definitions and present findings to leadership.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio, or lending analytics, ideally within a regulated lending or financial services environment.
- Working knowledge of core credit risk concepts: delinquency and non-performing loan metrics, vintage/cohort analysis, concentration risk, credit loss provisioning.
- Strong SQL skills and experience with BI or data visualisation tools.
- Strong, structured problem-solving and analytical reasoning.
- Ability to translate portfolio risk findings into clear recommendations for leadership.
- Independent and proactive, comfortable operating with ambiguity, and rigorous about data governance.

title: Senior People Analytics Specialist

GoTo is looking for a Senior People Analytics Specialist who is passionate about turning people data into meaningful insights and better decisions.

title: Business Analyst
description_text:
Are you passionate about solving business problems through process improvement, data, and automation? Do you enjoy turning complex operational challenges into structured solutions that create measurable business impact?

We're looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Business Analyst to join our Business Performance & Transformation (BPT) team. In this role, you'll help assess, standardize, and optimize business processes while supporting automation and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and enable scalable growth across ATI.

You'll partner with stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, Technology, and BPT to gather requirements, map current and future-state processes, and build data-driven recommendations that guide business decisions and transformation priorities.


Key Responsibilities::
- Lead process improvement and automation initiatives from discovery through implementation, including business assessment, requirements gathering, user acceptance testing (UAT), and rollout
- Own project scope, timelines, and delivery while ensuring initiatives are completed on time and aligned with business objectives
- Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, Technology, and Business Performance & Transformation (BPT) to facilitate workshops, align priorities, and communicate project progress, risks, and key decisions
- Analyze current-state processes and design standardized future-state processes, reports, templates, and solution recommendations that improve efficiency and scalability
- Develop business cases by evaluating expected benefits, implementation effort, and business impact to support project prioritization and investment decisions
- Drive the successful rollout of proven solutions across multiple operational teams by creating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, and best practices
- Monitor project outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence
- Translate complex operational and performance data into clear, structured, and persuasive narratives
- Develop executive-ready presentations for QBRs, client engagements, leadership reviews, and strategic discussions
- Work closely with Operations and BPT teams to extract meaningful business insights from performance data
- Partner with senior stakeholders across Operations, Commercial, BPT, and Executive Leadership
- Act as a thought partner in shaping strategic messaging and executive communication

Is this you?:
- More than 4 years of experience in business analysis, process analysis, or business process improvement, with a proven track record of leading projects from initiation to implementation and delivering measurable business outcomes
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)
- Hands-on experience using at least one Business Intelligence (BI) tool, such as Power BI, Looker, or Tableau, to analyze, model, and visualize data
- Strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
- Experience documenting business requirements, process maps, workflows, and business cases
- Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment
- Experience with process automation, Business Process Management (BPM), or continuous improvement initiatives
- Understanding of ETL processes, data warehouse concepts, or data transformation
- Experience using project management or collaboration tools such as JIRA
- Exposure to the travel, BPO, consulting, or shared services industry
- Professional certifications such as CBAP, Agile/Scrum, Lean, or Six Sigma
- Previous people management experience
- Deep software engineering or programming expertise
- Exceptional storytelling and narrative structuring ability
- Strong PowerPoint and presentation development capability (non-negotiable)
- Ability to simplify complex operational topics into compelling executive messaging
- Strong commercial awareness and business acumen
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Be Part of ATI's Journey

At ATI Business Group, we bring unparalleled knowledge of the travel and hospitality industry to every aspect of our clients' businesses. Through operational expertise, innovative technology, and exceptional talent, we deliver solutions that optimize operations, elevate customer experiences, and accelerate business growth.

Since 2002, we've grown into a global team of 2,000+ professionals, partnering with leading travel and hospitality organizations worldwide. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping businesses scale, adapt, and grow while creating meaningful career opportunities along the way.

Join us and help shape the future of travel and hospitality.

description_text:
BukuWarung is an accounting app that helps MSMEs to manage their cash and credit transactions. Merchants receive 3x faster repayments and see increased cash flow due to the automatic payment reminders sent by the app. The app tracks all transactions including credit, expense and sales, and helps merchants get cash flow visibility through business reports.
BukuWarung's vision is to empower 60 million MSMEs in Indonesia to become financially aware and enable them to manage and grow their business using our technology platform starting with digital bookkeeping and payments. We are backed by East Ventures, Agaeti Convergence Ventures, Golden Gate Ventures, Tanglin Venture Partners and Sampoerna. We have advisors & angels from companies such as Grab, GoJek, Flipkart, PayPal, Carousell, Modalku, Rapyd, Mastercard, Instarem.

- You are someone with 0-2 years of experience working with data
